articles.title: Panthers host veteran CB for visit on Tuesday
articles.summary: The Panthers brought in a veteran CB for a visit on Tuesday.
articles.body:
The Carolina Panthers are continuing to sniff out their options at a position of dire need.

Per the league transaction report, the team hosted cornerback Jack Jones for a visit on Tuesday.

Jones began his NFL career as a fourth-round pick of the New England Patriots from the 2022 draft. He's gone on to pick up additional stints with the Las Vegas Raiders (2023 to 2024), Miami Dolphins (2025) and, most recently, the San Francisco 49ers (2026).

In his five pro campaigns, Jones has made 38 starts over 66 outings. He's totaled 224 combined tackles and eight interceptions—four of which he returned for touchdowns.

San Francisco fielded Jones in seven contests this season. He recorded 23 snaps on defense and three on special teams prior to his release last week.

Down starters Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson, Carolina only has three cornerbacks on their active roster—Chau Smith-Wade and rookies Will Lee III and Malcolm DeWalt IV.

articles.title: Jets sign OL Blake Freeland off Bengals' practice squad
articles.summary: The Jets signed offensive tackle Blake Freeland off the Bengals' practice squad, the team announced Tuesday.
articles.body:
The Jets signed offensive tackle Blake Freeland off the Bengals' practice squad, the team announced Tuesday.

In a corresponding move, the Jets placed offensive lineman Max Mitchell on injured reserve. They also released cornerback Tre Brown from injured reserve.

Freeland joined the Bengals' practice squad after the Colts waived him on Aug. 31. In the preseason, he played 144 offensive snaps over the Colts' three games.

Freeland, who played collegiately at BYU, was selected by Indianapolis in the fourth round of the 2023 draft. He made nine starts as a rookie, while appearing in 15 total games. In 2024, he appeared in eight games and logged 36 special teams snaps and 23 on offense. Freeland missed the entire 2025 season with a fracture in his right leg.

Mitchell was diagnosed with a concussion during a Week 7 practice, and he has missed the past two games. This season, he has played 22 special teams snaps over the first six weeks. Mitchell, who played collegiately at Louisiana, was selected by the Jets in the fourth round of the 2022 draft and has played 51 games.

Brown went on injured reserve on Aug. 30.

articles.title: Gasperini warns: “I don’t know when Gollini will be back.”
articles.summary: Pierluigi Gollini, shortly before Manchester United vs. Roma, suffered a back injury and was unable to play in the match, which the Giallorossi lost 3-2. The...
articles.body:
Pierluigi Gollini, shortly before Manchester United vs. Roma, suffered a back injury and was unable to play in the match, which the Giallorossi lost 3-2.

The Roman side, having taken a two-goal lead (Soulé, Malen (R)), then fell behind in the second half, conceding three goals (Bruno Fernandes (R), Da Cunha scored a brace).

Gollini's replacement, Vasquez, also saved the former Udinese player's penalty, but the referee retaken the penalty for Cristante's alleged invasion of the penalty area.

The goalkeeper, reinstated after Svilar's injury, bears no particular responsibility for the goals conceded, except for the final one, where he could have been more ready to hit his own post, but Da Cunha's shot was still difficult to stop given the monstrous power with which he fired.

The former AC Milan player could however defend Roma's goal on Saturday in view of the last match before the break against Sassuolo.

Gian Piero Gasperini, in a press conference, discussed Gollini's condition. He was sidelined today against Manchester United with a back injury and replaced by Vasquez: "I don't know if he'll be able to return on Saturday, we'll see."

The alarm bells are ringing at Roma, with the former AC Milan goalkeeper warming up to defend the Giallorossi goal again on Saturday ahead of Roma vs. Sassuolo. The next few days will be crucial to see if Gollini will be able to grit his teeth.
